metadata.methods_description: Data were collected during 60 total sessions over 10 days with ten sessions daily, each approximately 25 minutes. Each session consisted of five segments: 2-minute baseline (no cells), 5-minute treatment (still), 5-minute treatment (movement allowed), 5-minute treatment (still), and 2-minute post-treatment baseline. Conditions included: live cells (40 sessions), no cells/medium only (10 sessions), and dead/x-rayed cells (10 sessions). Both the practitioner and experimenter were blinded to cell type. Matching control samples were treated by a sham therapist at a different location.
